question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: "**times**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Times**" refers to multiple instances of a specific moment or duration.
 
• In the sentence, the phrase "**At the best of times**" is an idiom that means "under the most favourable or ideal circumstances."
 
• It's often used to describe a situation when things are going well or smoothly.
 
• Here's the sentence with the blank filled in: "*At the best of times, a story is a slippery thing.*"
 
• This means that even when everything is going well or under the most favourable circumstances, a story can still be tricky or elusive to handle or understand.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**Time**," refers to a singular moment or duration.
 
• "**Schedule**," refers to a planned list of activities or events and would not make sense in the given context.
 
• "**Clock**," refers to a device used to measure and display time.
